page.overview:
Who is Fionna the Human?

Fionna is an Adventure Time minifigure that appears in LEGO Fortnite.

Fionna the Human is a purchasable skin in-game with the Fionna the Human Bundle for 1,500 V-Bucks or with the Fionna and Cake Bundle for 2,800 V-Bucks
